t: Fortress Trade 9" Roller Tray Inserts are transparent plastic liners designed to protect and extend the life of 9" paint roller trays. These durable plastic inserts are compatible with Fortress Trade 9" roller trays. Ideal for professional decorators and painters, these practical painting accessories allow for quick colour changes on-site and easy clean-up, making them a useful addition to any painting project. The transparent design helps monitor paint levels efficiently, ensuring a smooth and uninterrupted workflow for trade painting tasks.
b: Compatible with Fortress Trade 9" Roller Tray
